name: C++ 3 — Practice Lab (Control Structures)
description: Guided learner workspace for the third lab of a beginner C++ course (3×45 min), where the learner writes short code fragments themselves. Core exercises: a simple if with the frost-warning task (G03_01), an if–else parity check (G03_02), an else-if chain with boundary values (G03_03), switch/case/break/default (G03_04), while (G03_05), do–while (G03_06), for (G03_07), then two composition tasks: counting even numbers (G03_08) and summing the multiples of three (G03_09). Closing multiple-choice quiz (T1) and output-prediction test (T2), followed by one optional extra task. The learner edits, saves, compiles and runs (RUN button or g++ -std=c++20 in the workspace terminal); no homework.
